description: The VRM_REVENUE_CONTINGENCIES_ contains both seeded and user-defined revenue contingency definitions.

columns.name: SET_ID

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the revenue contingency.

columns.name: END_DATE

columns.name: REVENUE_POLICY_ID

columns.name: PRIMARY_REMOVAL_EVENT

columns.name: OPTIONAL_REMOVAL_EVENT
columns.description: Optional removal event to recognize revenue.

columns.name: EXPIRATION_DAYS
columns.description: Number of days from the Date considered for fulfillment to automatically consider the additional satisfaction event as fully satisfied.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: POLICY_ATTACHED
columns.description: Contingency will be attached to the revenue line when policy is violated. Values are from lookup VRM_POLICY_ATTACHED.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_SE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Additional satisfaction event used in the rule. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_ADDL_SATIS_EVENTS.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the rule is active.

columns.name: ASE_FULFILLMENT_DATE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Date that is considered for the automatic fulfillment of additional satisfaction events. The additional satisfaction event is considered to be fulfilled when the number of days specified in the setup have elapsed starting with the selected date. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_DATE_ADDL_SATIS_EVENT.

columns.name: IN_USE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the record is in use and cannot be deleted. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: PRIORITY
columns.description: Priority of the additional satisfaction event rule for an additional satisfaction event. The lower the number, the higher its priority.
